'''Abdullah Al Mamun''' (born 31 December 1966) is a Bangladeshi physicist who is a professor of physics at [[Jahangirnagar University]], [[Dhaka]], Bangladesh.<ref name="The Daily Star">{{citation|title=JU Faculty selected as the recipient of Bessel Research Award|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/campus/2009/05/05/newsroom.htm|date=31 May 2009|newspaper=[[The Daily Star (Bangladesh)|The Daily Star]]}}.</ref><ref name="BAS">{{cite web |url=http://www.bas.org.bd/awards/gold-medal-award.html |title=Academy Gold Medal Award |website=Bangladesh Academy of Sciences |access-date=2012-07-25 |archive-date=26 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150926174053/http://www.bas.org.bd/awards/gold-medal-award.html }}</ref>

==Early life and education==
A A Mamun (son of Darbesh Ali and Rizia Ali) was born in [[Dhamrai Upazila]],{{citation needed|date=December 2024}} [[Dhaka]], [[East Pakistan]] (now [[Bangladesh]]) on 31 December 1966,<ref name="juniv">{{cite web|year=2011|title=JU People Portal|url=http://people.juniv.edu/people.php?pid=mamunphys|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120620154032/http://people.juniv.edu/people.php?pid=mamunphys|archive-date=20 June 2012|access-date=25 July 2012|publisher=[[Jahangirnagar University]]}}</ref> and passed the [[Secondary School Certificate]] and [[Higher Secondary School Certificate|Higher Secondary Certificate]] examinations, from Kushura Abbas Ali High School (Dhamrai Upazila, Dhaka) and  [[Government Science College, Dhaka|Government Science College]] ([[Tejgaon Thana]], Dhaka) in 1981 and 1983, respectively.{{citation needed|date=December 2024}}

[[File:Mamun with Naruhito (Crown Prince of Japan) at IYV Program'89.jpg|thumb|Mamun with [[Naruhito]] at "International Youth Village Program-1989" in [[Fukuoka]], [[Japan]].]]
Mamun attended [[Jahangirnagar University]], and passed [[Bachelor of Science]] and [[Master of Science]] in [[physics]] in 1986 (held in 1989) and 1987 (held in 1991), respectively.<ref name="juniv" />  On the  basis of his extraordinary academic results, and performances in other activities at the university, Mamun was given an opportunity to represent Jahangirnagar University and Bangladesh in "International Youth Village Program 1989" held in [[Fukuoka]], [[Japan]], where he met with Naruhito, then crown prince of Japan.<ref name="juniv" />

Mamun gained a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in [[Plasma (physics)|plasma physics]] at the [[University of St Andrews]] by a Commonwealth Scholarship under the [[Commonwealth Scholarship and Fellowship Plan]].<ref name="juniv" /> He then performed postdoctoral studies in [[Germany]] and [[Scotland]] on an [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation|Alexander von Humboldt]] postdoctoral research fellowship, and a [[Commonwealth of Nations|Commonwealth]] postdoctoral research fellowship, respectively.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. Dr. A. A. Mamun|url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/en/connect/explore-the-humboldt-network/singleview?tx_rsmavhsolr_solrview%5BpPersonId%5D=1066548&cHash=74c8f2472eec413d38884b29423fb833|access-date=2021-08-12|website=www.humboldt-foundation.de|language=en}}</ref><ref name="juniv" /> As well as his faculty position at Jahangirnagar University, Mamun has a visiting position at the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] in [[Trieste]], Italy.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://portal.ictp.it/assoc/associateship-scheme/list-associates/associate.html?siscode=MAMUNNA7A7002|title=ICTP Associate and Federation Scheme Portal |website=International Centre for Theoretical Physics |access-date=31 January 2013}}</ref>

==Research contributions==
Mamun has published over 400 research articles in peer-reviewed international journals.<ref>{{GoogleScholar|id=uOLQ_SkAAAAJ|name=Dr. A. A. Mamun}}</ref> The [[Institute of Physics]] ([[London]]) published his textbook on [[dusty plasma]] physics.<ref name="The Daily Star"/>

According to a report published in [[PLOS Biology]], Mamun is one of the top 2% [position:130 out of 43,218 (2%)] scientists (in the world) working in the fields of fluids and plasma, as well as top 2% [position: 28,781 out of 159,624 (2%)] scientists (in the world) working in all branches of sciences (including engineering and medical sciences).<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Ioannidis|first1=John P. A.|last2=Boyack|first2=Kevin W.|last3=Baas|first3=Jeroen|date=2020-10-16|title=Updated science-wide author databases of standardized citation indicators|journal=PLOS Biology|language=en|volume=18|issue=10|article-number=e3000918|doi=10.1371/journal.pbio.3000918|issn=1545-7885|pmc=7567353|pmid=33064726 |doi-access=free }}</ref>

==Awards and honours==
[[File:Mamun receiving AvH award.jpg|thumb|Mamun receiving the Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel Research Award from the president of the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] in 2009.]]
* [[Bangladesh Academy of Sciences]] (BAS) Gold Medal in Physical Sciences (Junior Group: 2004)<ref name="BAS"/> 
* Bangladesh Academy of Sciences (BAS) Gold Medal in Physical Sciences (Senior Group: 2011)<ref name="BAS"/> 
* Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel Research Award in 2009 from the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]]<ref name="The Daily Star"/>
*[[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS) Prize-2006 for young physicists (Trieste, Italy) in recognition of his great contribution in physics.<ref>{{Cite web|title=TWAS Awards for Young Scientists-|url=http://www.bas.org.bd/awards/twas-young-scientist-award.html|access-date=2021-06-14|website=www.bas.org.bd}} {{Dead link|date=October 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>
*[[University Grants Commission (Bangladesh)]] Award - 2008 in Physical & Mathematical Sciences.<ref name="juniv" />
* ITCPP (ICTP) Young Physicist Medal and Certificate - 2000 from the International Topical Conference on Plasma Physics (ITCPP), [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] (ICTP).<ref name="juniv" />
*Elected Fellow, [[The World Academy of Sciences]], [[Trieste]], Italy.<ref>{{Cite web|title=TWAS elects 35 new TWAS Fellows|url=https://twas.org/article/twas-elects-35-new-twas-fellows|access-date=2021-06-14|website=TWAS|date=15 December 2020 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2021-01-26|title=3 Bangladeshi scientists elected TWAS fellows|url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2021/01/26/3-bangladeshi-scientists-elected-twas-fellows|access-date=2021-06-14|work=Dhaka Tribune}}</ref>
*Elected Fellow, The [[Bangladesh Academy of Sciences]], Dhaka, Bangladesh.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Fellows of BAS|url=http://www.bas.org.bd/fellowship/list-of-fellows-.html|access-date=2021-06-17|website=www.bas.org.bd|archive-date=21 December 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191221162403/http://bas.org.bd/fellowship/list-of-fellows-.html}}</ref>
Mamun has also been honored by a number of honorary appointments for his scientific contribution to physics. The important ones are as follows:

* Director of `Wazed Miah Science Research Centre' at [[Jahangirnagar University]], Savar, Dhaka, Bangladesh.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jahangirnagar University|url=https://www.juniv.edu/center/wmsrc|access-date=2021-08-10|website=www.juniv.edu}}</ref>
* Members of the governing bodies of '[[National Museum of Science and Technology (Bangladesh)|National Museum of Science and Technology]]'  as well as '[[Bangladesh National Scientific and Technical Documentation Centre]]'.<ref name="juniv" /> 
* Guest Editors of a special issue in ''Journal of Plasma Physics'' published by the Cambridge University Press,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Eliasson|first1=B.|last2=Stenflo|first2=L.|last3=Bingham|first3=R.|last4=Mendonça|first4=J. T.|last5=Mamun|first5=A. A.|last6=Shaikh|first6=D.|date=August 2010|title=Preface|journal=Journal of Plasma Physics|language=en|volume=76|issue=3–4|page=257|doi=10.1017/S0022377809990936|bibcode=2010JPlPh..76..257E |issn=1469-7807|doi-access=free}}</ref> and of a special issue in ''Review of Modern Plasma Physics'' published by the [[Springer Nature]] (Japan).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Reviews of Modern Plasma Physics|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/41614/updates/18863512|access-date=2021-08-10|website=Springer|language=en}}</ref>
* Associate Editor of the Journal: ''Review of Modern Plasma Physics'' published by [[Springer Nature]] ([[Japan]]).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Reviews of Modern Plasma Physics|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/41614/editors|access-date=2021-08-10|website=Springer|language=en}}</ref>
* Editorial Board Member of the journal: ''Advances in Astrophysics'' published by Isaac Scientific Publishing ([[Hong Kong]]).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Advances in Astrophysics, AdAp|url=http://www.isaacpub.org/EditorialBoard.aspx?ids=4|access-date=2021-08-10|website=www.isaacpub.org}}</ref>
* Regular Associate of the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] ([[Trieste]], Italy) appointed twice (from 1 January 1998 to 31 December 2002, and from 1 January 2009 to 31 December 2013).<ref>{{Cite web|title=List of Associates — ICTP Portal|url=https://portal.ictp.it/assoc/associateship-scheme/list-associates/associate.html?siscode=MAMUNNA7A7002|access-date=2021-08-10|website=portal.ictp.it}}</ref>
